## § flow-triage

## Playbook: triage
Use when: pending decisions of one project

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user, or `items[].projectId` of `get_workspace_decision_inbox` | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "Triage incomplete: <tool> failed: <error text>."
1. CALL `get_project_decision_inbox` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","requiresActionOnly":true,"limitCount":100} [A]
   Make no reply, update, resolve or create call in this playbook, even for a thread that looks easy to fix.
   IF the call returns an error that contains "owner surface" → SAVE: inbox = none; inboxNote = "inbox denied (no project governance role); list built from the sweep"; go to step 2.
   IF the call returns any other error → STOP. Say: "Triage incomplete: get_project_decision_inbox failed: <error text>."
   SAVE: inbox = each item of result.items: threadId, title, status, assignedTo, latestMessageAt, blockedAishJobIds; inboxNote = "none"
2. CALL `list_governance_threads` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   Always make this call: the inbox never shows decided threads whose artifact is still missing.
   SAVE: threads = result.items; pages = 1; cursor = result.nextCursor
   IF result.hasMore != true → go to step 5.
3. CALL `list_governance_threads` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","limitCount":100,"cursor":"<saved:cursor>"} [A]
   SAVE: threads = <saved:threads> plus result.items; pages = 2; cursor = result.nextCursor
   IF result.hasMore != true → go to step 5.
4. CALL `list_governance_threads` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","limitCount":100,"cursor":"<saved:cursor>"} [A]
   SAVE: threads = <saved:threads> plus result.items; pages = 3
   IF result.hasMore == true → SAVE: inboxNote = "only the 300 most recent threads were read"; go to step 5.
5. CALL `get_project` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: workspaceId = result.workspaceId; projectName = result.name; roleHolders = each "<role> <userId>" of result.governanceAssignments, else "none"
6. SAVE: pending = the items of <saved:inbox>, plus each item of <saved:threads> with status "open", "answered" or "decision-needed", an empty decisionOutcome and an id not already in the list
   SAVE: pending = <saved:pending> sorted: first status "decision-needed"; then a non-empty blockedAishJobIds; then the oldest latestMessageAt
   SAVE: decided = each item of <saved:threads> with status "resolved" or "closed", decisionOutcome.type "create-activity", "derive-requirement" or "propose-change-set", and an empty decisionOutcome.actionTargetId
     Not pending, leave out: outcome type "clarification", "publication-note" or "no-action", or an actionTargetId that is set.
   SAVE: decider of each pending item = its assignedTo exactly as returned (a userId such as usr_x), else "unassigned"
     Never turn a userId into a person's name. Copy titles as returned; a thread without a title is named by its id only.

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <saved:workspaceId>/<input:projectId> (<saved:projectName>)
Done: read-only, nothing changed: <count of <saved:pending>> pending + <count of <saved:decided>> decided with artifact pending
Evidence: <each <saved:pending> item: "<threadId> (<status>, <decider>[, holds <blockedAishJobIds>])"> | no pending thread; sweep <saved:pages> page(s): <each <saved:decided> item: "<id> <status> <decisionOutcome.type> '<decisionOutcome.actionTitle>' without actionTargetId"> | no decided thread without its artifact; <saved:inboxNote>
Pending: <each pending item: "<decider> decides <threadId>" or "<threadId>: no decider assigned (role holders: <saved:roleHolders>)">; <"jobs <blockedAishJobIds> held until <threadId> is resolved"> ; <"artifact of <id> not created"> | none
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | one action: the decider of the first pending thread decides it | assign a decider to <threadId> (playbook update-thread) | the decider orders the artifact of <id> (playbook create-artifact) | none>
```
status: open | answered | decision-needed | resolved | closed, from steps 1-4. Never claim a thread is pending or decided unless step 6 listed it; never write a person's name for a userId.

## § flow-open-thread

## Playbook: open-thread
Use when: open a thread asking for a decision

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.

- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| targetType | "requirement", "baseline", "roadmap-item" or "roadmap-change-request" from the user; "activity" when the topic is one activity | STOP. Say: "Which requirement, baseline, roadmap item or change request is this about?" |
| targetId | the user, or an id read in skill lpm-requirements-scope (requirement, baseline) or lpm-roadmap (item, change request) | STOP. Say: "Which <input:targetType> exactly? (id)" — never guess it |
| question | the decision to ask for, one line | STOP. Say: "Which decision is needed?" |
| optionA | the first choice with its consequences (cost, risk, what changes, reversible or not), from the user | what the user asked for |
| optionB | the second choice with its consequences, from the user | keep the current scope |
| recommendation | the option the user recommends, with the reason | "A", with the user's reason |
| topic | short kebab-case words for the anchor ("pdf-export") | made from <input:question> |
| aiSpend | "yes" if the decision enables, expands or cuts AI or AISH spend | "no" |
| aiFields | the 7 AI fields the user gave: feature scope, benefit, budget/limit, fallback, owner, review date (YYYY-MM-DD), rollback trigger | "none" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "No thread was opened: <tool> failed: <error text>."
1. IF <input:targetType> == "activity" → switch to playbook activity-note.
   Governance threads cannot target activities; discussion about an activity is an activity comment.
2. CALL `get_project` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: workspaceId = result.workspaceId; deciders = each "<role> <userId>" of result.governanceAssignments, else "project owner (unassigned)"
   IF <input:targetType> is "roadmap-item" or "roadmap-change-request" and <saved:workspaceId> is empty → STOP. Say: "<input:projectId> has no workspace, so it cannot hold roadmap threads. Target a requirement or baseline."
   IF <input:targetType> != "roadmap-change-request" → go to step 4.
3. CALL `get_workspace_roadmap_change_request` {"workspaceId":"<saved:workspaceId>","changeRequestId":"<input:targetId>"} [A]
   IF result.status is "applied", "rejected", "withdrawn" or "superseded" → ASK: "Change request <input:targetId> is <result.status>. Open a thread on it anyway? (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
4. CALL `list_governance_threads` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","targetType":"<input:targetType>","targetId":"<input:targetId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   Always make this call before opening a thread.
   IF an item has status "open", "answered" or "decision-needed" → STOP. Say: "Thread <that item's id> ("<its title>") is already open on <input:targetId>. Reply there with playbook reply; no second thread was opened."
5. IF <input:aiSpend> == "yes" and <input:aiFields> does not hold all 7 fields → STOP. Say: "This decision changes AI spend. Give these fields first: <the missing ones of: feature scope, benefit, budget/limit, fallback, owner, review date (YYYY-MM-DD), rollback trigger>."
6. SAVE: content = this text, filled (labels in the user's language; facts and ids only from the user's message and steps 2-4; one recommendation; no option pre-selected; never write that a decision was made):
   ```text
   Decision needed: <input:question>
   Context: <facts with ids>
   Options:
     A) <input:optionA>
     B) <input:optionB>
     C) do nothing - consequences: <what stays as is>
   Recommendation: <input:recommendation>
   AI fields: <input:aiFields>   (write this line only when <input:aiSpend> == "yes")
   Decision requested from: <saved:deciders>
   ```
   SAVE: title = <input:question> cut to 120 characters; anchorKey = "<input:targetType>:<input:targetId>:<input:topic>"
7. CALL `create_governance_thread` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","targetType":"<input:targetType>","targetId":"<input:targetId>","title":"<saved:title>","content":"<saved:content>","anchorKey":"<saved:anchorKey>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "No thread was opened: <error text>. Do not retry before running this playbook again (step 4 finds a thread that was created)."
   SAVE: threadId = the id in "Governance thread created with ID: <id>"
   VERIFY: CALL `list_governance_threads` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","targetType":"<input:targetType>","targetId":"<input:targetId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or no item has id == <saved:threadId> and status "open" → STOP. Say: "Thread <saved:threadId> is not listed as open on <input:targetId>; do not open it again."

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <saved:workspaceId>/<input:projectId>/<input:targetType> <input:targetId>
Done: <thread <saved:threadId> opened, status open | nothing changed>
Evidence: <list_governance_threads shows <saved:threadId> open | none>; decision requested from <saved:deciders>
Pending: <the decider answers <saved:threadId> | none>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | the decider decides; then record it with playbook record-decision>
```
status: open | answered | decision-needed | resolved | closed, from step 4 or the VERIFY. Never claim the thread is open unless the VERIFY listed it; the thread never states a decision.

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| threadId | the user, `items[].threadId` of an inbox, or `items[].id` of `list_governance_threads` | STOP. Say: "Which thread? (id or title)" |
| text | the reply to post, from the user or written from facts you read (ids included) | STOP. Say: "What should the reply say?" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "No reply was posted: <tool> failed: <error text>."
1. IF <input:text> says that a decision was made ("decidiu", "decided", "aprovado", "approved") → switch to playbook record-decision.
   A reply never records a decision: only playbook record-decision handles one.
2. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" and result.scopes does not contain "portfolio:manage" → STOP. Say: "<the howToEnable text of the portfolio:manage item of result.unavailableToolGroups>. Remove and reinstall the connector and tick that box; disconnect and connect is not enough."
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → go to step 4.
3. CALL `get_governance_thread_resolution_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","threadId":"<input:threadId>","messageLimitCount":100} [A]
   SAVE: workspaceId = result.project.workspaceId; status = result.thread.status; targetType, targetId = those fields of result.traceability
   GO TO step 5
4. CALL `list_governance_threads` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   SAVE: workspaceId = workspaceId of the item whose id == <input:threadId>; status, targetType, targetId = those fields of that item
   IF no item has id == <input:threadId> → STOP. Say: "Thread <input:threadId> is not among the 100 most recent threads of <input:projectId>; check the id."
5. CALL `reply_governance_thread` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","threadId":"<input:threadId>","content":"<input:text>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "No reply was posted: <error text>. Do not retry before checking the thread: a retry posts the message twice."
   SAVE: messageId = the id in "Governance thread reply created with ID: <id>"
   VERIFY: CALL `list_governance_threads` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","targetType":"<saved:targetType>","targetId":"<saved:targetId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or no item has id == <input:threadId> with a latestMessagePreview that starts with the first 100 characters of <input:text> → STOP. Say: "Reply <saved:messageId> is not shown on <input:threadId>; do not post it again."

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)

## § flow-update-thread

## Playbook: update-thread
Use when: change a thread's status, decider or title

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| threadId | the user, `items[].threadId` of an inbox, or `items[].id` of `list_governance_threads` | STOP. Say: "Which thread? (id or title)" |
| status | "answered" or "decision-needed" from the user; "resolved", "closed" or "open" when the user asked for those | "same" |
| assignee | the decider's role ("project-owner", "product-owner", "delivery-lead") or userId, from the user | "same" |
| title | the new title from the user | "same" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "Nothing was changed: <tool> failed: <error text>."
1. IF <input:status> is "resolved" or "closed" → switch to playbook record-decision.
   IF <input:status> == "open" → switch to playbook reopen.
   A bare status change never records a decision.
2. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "Changing a thread needs an LPM API key (profile full or requirements), or the LPM web UI."
3. CALL `get_governance_thread_resolution_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","threadId":"<input:threadId>","messageLimitCount":100} [A]
   SAVE: workspaceId = result.project.workspaceId; oldStatus = result.thread.status; oldAssignee = result.decision.assignedTo, else ""; oldTitle = result.thread.title, else ""
   IF <saved:oldStatus> is "resolved" or "closed" → STOP. Say: "<input:threadId> is <saved:oldStatus>: its decision is recorded. To change it, the decider must order a reopen (playbook reopen)."
4. CALL `get_project` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: assignments = each "<role> <userId>" of result.governanceAssignments
   SAVE: newAssignee = the userId of the item whose role == <input:assignee> or whose userId == <input:assignee>; <saved:oldAssignee> when <input:assignee> == "same"
   IF <input:assignee> != "same" and <saved:newAssignee> is empty → STOP. Say: "<input:assignee> holds no governance role here. Pick one: <saved:assignments>."
   SAVE: newStatus = <input:status>, or <saved:oldStatus> when "same"; newTitle = <input:title>, or <saved:oldTitle> when "same"
   IF <saved:newStatus> == "decision-needed" and <saved:newAssignee> is empty → STOP. Say: "Who must decide <input:threadId>? <saved:assignments>"
   The assignee is always a userId from this call, never a person's name.
5. ASK: "Set thread <input:threadId>: status <saved:oldStatus> → <saved:newStatus>, decider <saved:oldAssignee> → <saved:newAssignee>, title \"<saved:oldTitle>\" → \"<saved:newTitle>\"? (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
6. CALL `update_governance_thread` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","threadId":"<input:threadId>","status":"<saved:newStatus>","assignedTo":"<saved:newAssignee>","title":"<saved:newTitle>"} [C]
   IF the call returns an error that contains "permission" → STOP. Say: "Not changed: this credential has no governance role. Ask the project owner to change it, or to grant product-owner or delivery-lead."
   IF the call returns any other error → STOP. Say: "Not changed: <error text>."
   VERIFY: CALL `get_governance_thread_resolution_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","threadId":"<input:threadId>","messageLimitCount":100} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.thread.status != <saved:newStatus> or result.decision.assignedTo != <saved:newAssignee> (empty = null) or result.thread.title != <saved:newTitle> (empty = null) → STOP. Say: "<input:threadId> does not show the change: status <result.thread.status>, decider <result.decision.assignedTo>."
   SAVE: status = result.thread.status

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <saved:workspaceId>/<input:projectId>/<input:threadId>
Done: <status <saved:oldStatus> → <saved:status>; decider <saved:newAssignee>; title "<saved:newTitle>" | nothing changed>
Evidence: <get_governance_thread_resolution_context shows the new values | none>
Pending: <<saved:newAssignee> decides <input:threadId> | none>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | the decider decides; then playbook record-decision>
```
status: open | answered | decision-needed | resolved | closed, from step 3 or the VERIFY. Never claim a change the VERIFY did not show; never write a person's name for a userId.

Use when: reopen a decided thread

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| threadId | the user, or `items[].id` of `list_governance_threads` | STOP. Say: "Which thread? (id or title)" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "Nothing was reopened: <tool> failed: <error text>."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "Reopening a thread needs an LPM API key (profile full or requirements), or the LPM web UI."
2. CALL `get_governance_thread_resolution_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","threadId":"<input:threadId>","messageLimitCount":100} [A]
   SAVE: workspaceId = result.project.workspaceId; oldStatus = result.thread.status; heldJobs = result.thread.blockedAishJobIds, else "none"; erased = result.decision.outcome.type and "<result.decision.outcome.summary>", else "no outcome"
   IF <saved:oldStatus> is neither "resolved" nor "closed" → STOP. Say: "<input:threadId> is <saved:oldStatus>; it is not decided, so there is nothing to reopen."
3. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Reopening <input:threadId> erases its decision (<saved:erased>); jobs <saved:heldJobs> would be held again and need approval again. Only the decider (project owner, product owner or delivery lead) can order it: \"reopen <input:threadId>\"."
4. CALL `update_governance_thread` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","threadId":"<input:threadId>","status":"open","decisionOutcome":null} [O]
   IF the call returns an error that contains "must be queued" → STOP. Say: "Not reopened: the held jobs already ran. Reopen it in the LPM web UI or ask the owner."
   IF the call returns any other error → STOP. Say: "Not reopened: <error text>."
   VERIFY: CALL `get_governance_thread_resolution_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","threadId":"<input:threadId>","messageLimitCount":100} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.thread.status != "open" or result.decision.outcome is set → STOP. Say: "<input:threadId> is <result.thread.status>; it was not reopened."
   SAVE: status = result.thread.status

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <saved:workspaceId>/<input:projectId>/<input:threadId>
Done: <reopened: status <saved:oldStatus> → <saved:status>; erased <saved:erased> | nothing changed>
Evidence: <the order "<the quoted order>"; get_governance_thread_resolution_context shows status open and no outcome | none>
Pending: <jobs <saved:heldJobs> held again; they need approval again in lpm-aish-jobs | none>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | the decider decides again; then playbook record-decision>
```
status: open | answered | decision-needed | resolved | closed, from step 2 or the VERIFY. Never claim the thread is reopened unless the VERIFY showed status open.


## § flow-record-decision

## Playbook: record-decision
Use when: record a decision, or ask the decider to confirm it

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project?" |
| threadId | the user or an inbox `threadId` | STOP. Say: "Which thread?" |
| decision | the decider's own words, quoted from the user's message | STOP. Say: "What exactly was decided?" |
| decider | the person and role the user names: "Carla, dona do projeto" → "Carla (project-owner)"; roles project-owner, product-owner, delivery-lead | STOP. Say: "Who decided?" |
| who | "self" only if the user says "eu decidi" / "I decided"; else "relayed" ("X decidiu", a thread message) | "relayed" |
| outcomeType | activity "create-activity", requirement "derive-requirement", change set "propose-change-set", baseline note "publication-note", nothing to create "clarification", not acting "no-action" | STOP. Say: "Record as which outcome?" |
| actionTitle | the artifact title, from the decision words | "" |
| alsoCreate | "yes" if the user also asked for the artifact | "no" |
| aiSpend | "yes" if it changes AI or AISH spend | "no" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "Nothing was recorded: <tool> failed: <error text>."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "Recording needs an LPM API key; here, post the decision with playbook reply."
2. CALL `get_governance_thread_resolution_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","threadId":"<input:threadId>","messageLimitCount":100} [A]
   Always make this call first.
   SAVE: workspaceId = result.project.workspaceId; targetType, targetId = those fields of result.traceability; heldJobs = result.thread.blockedAishJobIds
   IF result.decision.outcome is set and its actionTargetId is empty and <input:alsoCreate> == "yes" → switch to playbook create-artifact.
   IF result.decision.outcome is set → STOP. Say: "<input:threadId> already records <result.decision.outcome.type>; not recorded again."
3. CALL `get_project` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   Always make this call: only role holders decide.
   SAVE: holders = each "<role> <userId>" of result.governanceAssignments; deciderId = userId of the item whose role or userId is in <input:decider>, else empty
   IF <saved:deciderId> is not empty → go to step 5.
4. CALL `list_project_assignable_members` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: deciderId = uid of the only item whose displayName or email contains the name in <input:decider> (never repeat hourlyRate)
   IF no item or 2+ items match, or <saved:deciderId> is not a userId in <saved:holders> → STOP. Say: "<input:decider> holds no governance role, so this is no decision yet. Role holders: <saved:holders>."
5. SAVE: type = "clarification" when <saved:targetType> starts with "roadmap" and <input:outcomeType> is "create-activity", "derive-requirement" or "propose-change-set", else <input:outcomeType>; roadmap = "yes" in that case, else "no"
   SAVE: confirm = "Record as <saved:type>: \"<input:decision>\"? (<input:decider> confirms)"
   IF <input:who> == "self" → go to step 7.
6. CALL `reply_governance_thread` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","threadId":"<input:threadId>","content":"<saved:confirm>"} [A]
   Record nothing: a relayed decision, a thread message or the relayer's "yes" is not the decider's order.
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "No request posted: <error text>. Check the thread before a retry."
   SAVE: messageId = the id in "Governance thread reply created with ID: <id>"
   VERIFY: CALL `list_governance_threads` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","targetType":"<saved:targetType>","targetId":"<saved:targetId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or item <input:threadId> has no latestMessagePreview starting with the first 100 characters of <saved:confirm> → STOP. Say: "The request is not shown on <input:threadId>; do not post it again."
   SAVE: next = "<input:decider> confirms in this chat or the thread; then rerun record-decision"; go to Answer.
7. IF <input:aiSpend> == "yes" and <input:decision> lacks any of: feature scope, benefit, budget/limit, fallback, owner, review date (YYYY-MM-DD), rollback trigger → STOP. Say: "<input:decider> must first state: <the missing ones>."
8. SAVE: finalStatus = "closed" when <saved:type> == "no-action", else "resolved"; title = <input:actionTitle>
9. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Recording needs <input:decider>'s own order here (\"I decided …; record it\"). Nothing was recorded."
   The owner is the decider <saved:deciderId> speaking for themselves.
10. CALL `resolve_governance_thread_with_outcome` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","threadId":"<input:threadId>","outcomeType":"<saved:type>","summary":"<input:decision>","actionTitle":"<saved:title>","status":"<saved:finalStatus>"} [O]
   IF the call returns an error that contains "queued or terminal" → STOP. Say: "A held job is running; nothing recorded. Rerun once it ends."
   IF the call returns any other error → STOP. Say: "Not recorded: <error text>."
   VERIFY: CALL `get_governance_thread_resolution_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","threadId":"<input:threadId>","messageLimitCount":100} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.thread.status != <saved:finalStatus> or result.decision.outcome.type != <saved:type> → STOP. Say: "<input:threadId> does not show the decision as recorded."
   SAVE: heldJobs = result.thread.blockedAishJobIds; recorded = "<saved:type> \"<input:decision>\", status <saved:finalStatus>"
11. IF <saved:roadmap> == "yes" → STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-roadmap.md`. Say: "Recorded as clarification. Change an item or CR by change request. A NEW item: no change request can create it, even in enforce mode; only on the owner's explicit order, create_workspace_roadmap_item without lifecycle (draft). Then link it with playbook create-artifact."
12. IF <saved:type> is "create-activity", "derive-requirement" or "propose-change-set" and <input:alsoCreate> == "yes" → switch to playbook create-artifact.

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <saved:workspaceId>/<input:projectId>/<input:threadId> on <saved:targetType> <saved:targetId>
Done: <request <saved:messageId> posted; decision NOT recorded, nothing created | recorded <saved:recorded> | nothing changed>
Evidence: "<input:decision>" (<relayed by the user | ordered here: "<the quoted order>">); decider <input:decider> = <saved:deciderId>; <re-read values>
Pending: <<input:decider> must confirm | jobs <saved:heldJobs> need approval in lpm-aish-jobs | artifact not created | none>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | <saved:next> | playbook create-artifact | none>
```
status: open | answered | decision-needed | resolved | closed. Never claim a decision is recorded unless step 10's VERIFY showed it.


## § flow-create-artifact

## Playbook: create-artifact
Use when: create or link a decided artifact

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project?" |
| threadId | the user, or playbook record-decision | STOP. Say: "Which thread holds the decision?" |
| artifactId | an existing artifact to link: from skill lpm-roadmap, skill lpm-requirements-scope or an earlier run | "none" |
| artifactType | "roadmap-item", "roadmap-change-request", "change-set", "issue" or "requirement" | "none" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing more changed."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "This needs an LPM API key."
2. CALL `get_governance_thread_resolution_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","threadId":"<input:threadId>","messageLimitCount":100} [A]
   SAVE: workspaceId = result.project.workspaceId; status = result.thread.status; type, summary, actionTitle = those fields of result.decision.outcome (actionTitle "" if null)
   SAVE: issueTitle, issueText = title, description of result.drafts.issue.draft; reqBaseline = result.drafts.requirement.currentBaseline.id; reqTitle, reqText, reqType = title, description, type of result.drafts.requirement.draft
   IF <saved:status> is neither "resolved" nor "closed" → STOP. Say: "<input:threadId> is <saved:status>: record the decision first (playbook record-decision)."
   IF result.decision.outcome.actionTargetId is not empty → STOP. Say: "<input:threadId> is already linked to <result.decision.outcome.actionTargetId>."
   IF <input:artifactId> != "none" → SAVE: newId = <input:artifactId>; linkType = <input:artifactType>; created = "existing"; go to step 10.
   IF <saved:type> is neither "create-activity", "derive-requirement" nor "propose-change-set" → STOP. Say: "Outcome <saved:type>: nothing to create."
3. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Decision needed: create and link the artifact of <input:threadId> (\"<saved:summary>\")? Linking is owner-only: the decider must order it."
   Get this order before creating: an unlinked artifact stays orphaned.
4. IF <saved:type> == "propose-change-set" → STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-requirements-scope.md`. Say: "Create the change set there (it checks the WHOLE working-scope delta), then link it here (artifactType change-set)."
   IF <saved:type> == "derive-requirement" and <saved:reqBaseline> is empty → STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-requirements-scope.md`. Say: "<input:projectId> has no current baseline."
   IF <saved:type> == "derive-requirement" → go to step 7.
5. CALL `list_issues` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","status":"todo","limitCount":100} [A]
   Always make this call: a prior run may have created it.
   IF an item has title == <saved:issueTitle> → ASK: "Activity <its id> has this title; link it instead? (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
   IF an item has title == <saved:issueTitle> → SAVE: newId = its id; linkType = "issue"; created = "existing"; go to step 10.
6. CALL `create_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","title":"<saved:issueTitle>","description":"<saved:issueText>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Not created: <error text>. Rerun; step 5 finds a created copy."
   SAVE: newId = the id in "Issue created with ID: <id>"; linkType = "issue"; created = "new"
   VERIFY: CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:newId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.title != <saved:issueTitle> → STOP. Say: "<saved:newId> cannot be read back; not linked."
   GO TO step 10
7. CALL `list_requirements` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","baselineId":"<saved:reqBaseline>"} [A]
   Always make this call: a prior run may have created it.
   IF an item has title == <saved:reqTitle> → ASK: "Requirement <its id> has this title; link it instead? (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
   IF an item has title == <saved:reqTitle> → SAVE: newId = its id; linkType = "requirement"; created = "existing"; go to step 10.
8. ASK: "Create requirement \"<saved:reqTitle>\" (<saved:reqType>, pending) in current baseline <saved:reqBaseline>? It changes the working scope until a baseline is published. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
9. CALL `create_requirement` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","baselineId":"<saved:reqBaseline>","title":"<saved:reqTitle>","description":"<saved:reqText>","type":"<saved:reqType>","status":"pending"} [C]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Not created: <error text>. Rerun; step 7 finds a created copy."
   SAVE: newId = the id in "Requirement created with ID: <id>"; linkType = "requirement"; created = "new"
   VERIFY: CALL `list_requirements` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","baselineId":"<saved:reqBaseline>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or no item has id == <saved:newId> → STOP. Say: "<saved:newId> is not listed; not linked."
10. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Link <saved:linkType> <saved:newId> to <input:threadId>? Only the decider can order it."
11. CALL `resolve_governance_thread_with_outcome` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","threadId":"<input:threadId>","outcomeType":"<saved:type>","summary":"<saved:summary>","actionTitle":"<saved:actionTitle>","status":"<saved:status>","actionTargetType":"<saved:linkType>","actionTargetId":"<saved:newId>"} [O]
   It replaces the whole outcome: resend type, summary, actionTitle, status from step 2.
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "<saved:newId> exists but is NOT linked: <error text>. Never create it again; rerun with artifactId <saved:newId>."
   VERIFY: CALL `get_governance_thread_resolution_context` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","threadId":"<input:threadId>","messageLimitCount":100} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.decision.outcome.actionTargetId != <saved:newId> or result.decision.outcome.type != <saved:type> → STOP. Say: "<input:threadId> does not show the link to <saved:newId>."
   SAVE: reasonCodes = result.policy.automationPolicy.reasonCodes

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <saved:workspaceId>/<input:projectId>/<input:threadId> <saved:type>
Done: <<saved:created> <saved:linkType> <saved:newId> linked | <saved:linkType> <saved:newId> created, NOT linked | nothing created>
Evidence: order "<the quoted order>"; actionTargetId <saved:newId>; reasonCodes <saved:reasonCodes> | none
Pending: <none | change set review (lpm-requirements-scope) | baseline publication (owner) for <saved:newId>>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | none>
```
reasonCodes after a link include artifact-created-from-reviewed-draft. Never claim a link that step 11's VERIFY did not show.


## § flow-activity-note

## Playbook: activity-note
Use when: a note on one activity

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| issueId | the user or `.lpm-activity` | STOP. Say: "Which LPM activity? (id or title)" |
| text | the note to post, from the user | STOP. Say: "What should the note on <input:issueId> say?" |
| topic | short kebab-case words for this note ("pdf-layout"); new text gets a new topic | made from <input:text> |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "No note was posted: <tool> failed: <error text>."
1. IF <input:text> asks to change approved scope, a requirement, a baseline or the roadmap → STOP. Say: "This changes scope, so it needs a decision on the requirement, baseline or roadmap item, not on <input:issueId>. Which one? (id) Then I open a thread there with playbook open-thread."
   A comment records execution detail; it is never a decision.
2. CALL `create_comment` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>","content":"<input:text>","idempotencyKey":"gov-note-<input:issueId>-<input:topic>"} [A]
   SAVE: commentId = the id in "Comment created with ID: <id>"
   VERIFY: CALL `list_comments` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<input:issueId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or item <saved:commentId> is missing or its content does not start with the first 100 characters of <input:text> → STOP. Say: "Comment <saved:commentId> is not listed with this text; the key may belong to an older note: use a new topic."

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:projectId>/<input:issueId>
Done: <comment <saved:commentId> posted | nothing posted>
Evidence: <list_comments shows <saved:commentId> with the text | none>
Pending: none
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | none>
```
A governance thread was not opened: threads cannot target activities. Never claim the comment is posted unless the VERIFY listed it.
